items.title: RTX (NYSE:RTX) Delivers First SPY 6(V)4 Radar Array For Navy Destroyer Upgrade
items.summary: Raytheon, an RTX (NYSE:RTX) company, has delivered and installed the first SPY-6(V)4 radar array at Wallops Island. The radar is part of the U.S. Navy's Flight IIA Destroyer modernization and backfit program. Extensive testing of the SPY-6(V)4 system is expected to follow this initial installation. RTX is drawing investor attention with this SPY-6(V)4 milestone, which sits alongside a strong recent share price run. The stock last closed at $222.31, with returns of 3.3% over the past week,...
